LESSON: KUANDIKA 12.3.1 HOTUBA YA KUPASHA HABARI

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari
2. kutambua hotuba ya kupasha habari katika matini
3. kueleza ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua hotuba ya kupasha habari katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua hotuba ya kupasha habari katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kueleza ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 12.3.1 Hotuba ya Kupasha Habari important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya hotuba ya kupasha habari
2. kutambua hotuba ya kupasha habari katika matini
3. kueleza ujumbe, lugha na muundo wa hotuba ya kupasha habari

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
